top_choice_rationale: P001 rests on a simple, general mechanism: at the magic wavelength the differential light shift cancels, so many lattice-confined atoms become a frequency reference. It is a new principle rather than only a refinement, reproduced and compared across JILA, RIKEN, NIST, PTB, SYRTE and NPL at the 10^-18 level, with clean originator (Katori) and perfecter (Ye) attribution and a citation scope that avoids claiming lattice clocks are the only route. P002 is a mature, reproduced discovery but bundles quantum spin Hall and quantum anomalous Hall as one achievement and leaves unresolved credit (Mele, Hasan, Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang), so I rank it second, above no award.
